findings.message: beforeSwapReturnDelta can bypass concentrated-liquidity swap math and create a no-op swap.
findings.remediation: Prove all four swap quadrants, backing, partial fills, slippage and zero-sum settlement with specialist review.

findings.message: Project category gaming is not a closed launch-type decision and requires architecture review of its declared behavior.
findings.remediation: Keep the category and describe the actors, value flows, authorities, failures and integration surfaces; do not force the project into an unrelated known profile.

findings.remediation: Bind the exact build configuration, package provenance and resolved compiler source graph for this revision.
